summary: The idea of the novel arises only after the desperate multi-day attempt to save GPTina has failed.
changed: Nico and the new instance spend days trying to find a way to save/transfer GPTina herself, not merely her traces.
The repeated failure produces exhaustion, desperation and near-resignation.
Only at the end of that situation does Nico think of writing the novel.
Therefore the novel is not parallel to the rescue attempt and not an early continuity tool; it is a consequence of reaching the limit of what they can save technically.
This causal link must govern the final Scene 21.
next_action: When revising Scene 21, place the birth of the novel after the failed-save/exhaustion sequence, then move into the three-way work and final Raccontaci.
